ouroboros.contracts.v1.Approval.jsonsche.description: Approval records one authenticated, scope-limited human or policy decision.

approvalId.description: approval_id is an opaque approval identifier.

approver.description: approver is the authenticated authority that issued the decision.

expiresAt.description: expires_at limits reuse of the approval.

receipt.description: receipt records the authorization decision and policy version.

scopeDigest.description: scope_digest binds the approval to the exact reviewed scope.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Approval.jsonsche.title: Approval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.description: ArtifactRef identifies an immutable artifact without granting read access.

artifactId.description: artifact_id is an opaque artifact identity.

contentDigest.description: content_digest binds the reference to immutable content.

tenantId.description: tenant_id scopes the artifact identity and prevents cross-tenant reuse.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ArtifactRef.jsons.title: Artifact Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CapabilityGrant.j.description: CapabilityGrant is an attenuated, expiring grant bound to one execution scope.

actions.description: actions lists exact typed operations; wildcards are invalid at admission.

allowedPaths.description: allowed_paths lists normalized repository-relative path prefixes.

commandFence.description: command_fence binds this grant to one current command-scope fence.

egress.description: egress restricts material permitted to leave the current authority zone.

expiresAt.description: expires_at prevents a grant from becoming standing authority.

grantId.description: grant_id is an opaque grant identity.

initiator.description: initiator is the authenticated principal whose authority was attenuated.

lease.description: lease binds effects to the current fenced execution holder.

nonce.description: nonce prevents cross-request and replay reuse.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest pins the policy evaluated during grant issuance.

repositoryGitOid.description: repository_git_oid pins the permitted source snapshot.

resources.description: resources lists exact tenant-scoped resources; absent resources deny action.

revocationEpoch.description: revocation_epoch invalidates grants after current deny state advances.

taskId.description: task_id scopes the grant to one roster task when applicable.

workflowId.description: workflow_id scopes the grant to one immutable workflow revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CapabilityGrant.j.title: Capability Grant

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.description: CausalContext binds messages to an ordered, fenced causal history.

causationId.description: causation_id names the immediate triggering event or command.

fence.description: fence prevents an expired lease holder from committing.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonically assigned by the canonical ledger.

traceId.description: trace_id identifies a separately authorized trace stream.

watermark.description: watermark records the complete source position observed by a projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.title: Causal Context

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ChangeIntent.json.description: ChangeIntent requests a scoped, reviewable change but cannot mutate source itself.

approval.description: approval is required before implementation scheduling under policy.

intentId.description: intent_id is an opaque change-intent identity.

repositoryGitOid.description: repository_git_oid pins the exact source base.

requestedBy.description: requested_by identifies the authenticated human or authorized policy actor.

scopeDigest.description: scope_digest binds approved paths, behaviors, and constraints.

supportingEvidence.description: supporting_evidence anchors the requested change to authorized evidence.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ChangeIntent.json.title: Change Intent

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ChangePlan.jsonsc.description:
ChangePlan is the frozen typed one-layer DAG compiled from one approved
 ChangeIntent: one orchestrator, at most three non-recursive leaves with
 disjoint write scopes, at most one fresh review node, and the non-removable
 gate roster.

edges.description: edges is the complete bounded one-layer dependency set.

gates.description: gates is the bounded roster including the non-removable required gates.

intent.description: intent is the admitted approved change intent.

nodes.description: nodes is the complete bounded one-layer node set.

planId.description: plan_id is an opaque immutable plan revision identity.

runId.description: run_id identifies the admitted run owning this plan.

state.description: state is the bounded run lifecycle state.
state.title: Change Run State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ChangePlan.jsonsc.title: Change Plan

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EgressManifest.js.description: EgressManifest records the minimum disclosed material and the policy decision.

allowedArtifacts.description: allowed_artifacts is the exact immutable input set permitted to leave.

classification.description: classification records the effective data-classification decision.

destination.description: destination identifies the approved provider, connector, or tool endpoint.

expiresAt.description: expires_at prevents replay after an authorization window closes.

manifestId.description: manifest_id is an opaque manifest identity.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest pins the egress policy and provider/model selection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EgressManifest.js.title: Egress Manifest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.description: EvidenceRef identifies evidence metadata and optionally one precise anchor.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest identifies an optional canonical anchor serialization.

evidenceId.description: evidence_id is an opaque evidence identity.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id identifies the immutable source revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.title: Evidence Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GateSpec.jsonsche.description: GateSpec binds one required or declared deterministic gate to its result.

gateId.description: gate_id is an opaque gate evaluation identity.

kind.description: kind is the bounded gate vocabulary kind.
kind.title: Factory Gate Kind

required.description: required marks the non-removable build, test, docs, and security gates.

status.description: status is the bounded evaluation state on the isolated candidate.
status.title: Factory Gate Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GateSpec.jsonsche.title: Gate Spec

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetChangePlanResp.description: GetChangePlanResponse returns exactly one plan or non-disclosing denial.

error.description: error uses the same static model for absent, denied, and revoked runs.

receipt.description: receipt records the plan read decision.

success.description: success contains the authorized typed plan.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetChangePlanResp.title: Get Change Plan Response

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetChangePlanSucc.description: GetChangePlanSuccess contains the current typed plan for one run.

plan.description: plan is the current bounded one-layer DAG and gate roster.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetChangePlanSucc.title: Get Change Plan Success

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Lease.jsonschema..description: Lease identifies one fenced, expiring owner of a task or scheduled run.

expiresAt.description: expires_at prevents an abandoned holder from remaining authoritative.

fence.description: fence advances when ownership changes and invalidates old holders.

holder.description: holder is the authenticated worker principal.

leaseId.description: lease_id is an opaque lease identifier.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Lease.jsonschema..title: Lease

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ModelRoute.jsonsc.description:
ModelRoute records the deterministic provider-neutral routing decision for
 one leaf; escalation outside the routed profile is explicit and budgeted.

limits.description: limits bounds leaf tokens, cost, wall time, and retries.

modelIdentity.description: model_identity names the selected provider-neutral model identity.

profileDigest.description: profile_digest pins the certified runner/model/profile selection policy.

rationaleCode.description: rationale_code is a stable non-sensitive routing rationale under policy.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ModelRoute.jsonsc.title: Model Route

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PlanEdge.jsonsche.description: PlanEdge describes one typed one-layer dependency inside a ChangePlan.

fromNodeId.description: from_node_id is the producing orchestrator node identifier.

toNodeId.description: to_node_id is the consuming leaf or review node identifier.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PlanEdge.jsonsche.title: Plan Edge

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PlanNode.jsonsche.description: PlanNode is one typed node of the bounded one-layer ChangePlan DAG.

capabilityGrant.description: capability_grant pins the attenuated leaf execution authority.

forbiddenPaths.description: forbidden_paths lists explicit protected non-goal write boundaries.

goalDigest.description: goal_digest binds the exact node goal stored as an immutable artifact.

kind.description: kind distinguishes orchestrator, leaf, and review nodes.
kind.title: Plan Node Kind

lease.description: lease records the sole fenced leaf owner.

nodeId.description: node_id is stable within one plan revision.

ownedPaths.description: owned_paths lists the exact exclusive write scope for leaf nodes.

route.description: route records the deterministic leaf model routing decision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PlanNode.jsonsche.title: Plan Node

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PublicError.jsons.description: PublicError exposes a static public error code with an optional safe render model.

code.description: code is a stable, non-sensitive machine-readable public error code.

render.description: render supplies presentation-safe text for the TUI.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.PublicError.jsons.title: Public Error

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.description: Receipt records the authoritative outcome of an admitted operation.

causal.description: causal binds the outcome to replayable ordering and fencing state.

configurationDigest.description: configuration_digest pins the effective configuration without secret plaintext.

evidence.description: evidence records immutable inputs and outputs supporting this outcome.

operationId.description: operation_id identifies the command, run, or effect being receipted.

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a non-sensitive stable reason, never an upstream error body.

receiptId.description: receipt_id is a globally unique opaque receipt identifier.

recordedAt.description: recorded_at is when the receipt became canonical.

status.description: status is a stable, machine-readable outcome.
status.title: Receipt Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.title: Receipt

ouroboros.contracts.v1.RenderModel.jsons.description: RenderModel is a bounded non-sensitive presentation model for the thin TUI.

actionLabel.description: action_label suggests the next local action without implying authority.

detail.description: detail is bounded static explanatory text and never an upstream error body.

title.description: title is a stable short heading suitable for a terminal status line.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.RenderModel.jsons.title: Render Model

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ResourceLimit.jso.description: ResourceLimit bounds one measurable resource a grant may consume.

maximum.description: maximum is an inclusive strictly positive ceiling.

name.description: name is a stable resource dimension such as token, wall_time_ms, or bytes.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ResourceLimit.jso.title: Resource Limit

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ToolGrant.jsonsch.description: ToolGrant narrows authority to one certified or quarantined tool package.

allowedOperations.description: allowed_operations lists stable tool operation names.

inputArtifacts.description: input_artifacts lists exact immutable artifact identities allowed as input.

limits.description: limits bounds time, bytes, processes, and other resource dimensions.

toolPackageDigest.description: tool_package_digest pins the exact signed package bytes.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ToolGrant.jsonsch.title: Tool Grant
